coverage_gaps: Manual race/memtier members are inventoried but do not run on every PR.
Existing push-only/path-filtered workflows remain push-only/path-filtered; forecasts do not add execution.
Nested modules (benchmarks/experiments/third_party) and Haystack/JavaScript clients have manual or absent qualification; changes force full existing CI, not coverage expansion.
No package reverse closure or test-level elimination is qualified; production/test/script/unknown/new input changes choose full.
MVCC and sparse/owner paired benchmarks execute explicit head/base contexts; ordinary PR correctness uses merge candidate.

dynamic_consumers.behavior: AST/WalkDir discovery and go test subprocess producer witnesses; all TreeDB test/race members retained
tracked NUL Git path scan, UTF-8 content, retained RESULTS.json and fallback filesystem walk; broad TreeDB test/race ownership
markdown globs/walks, canonical specs and guides; benchmarks conservatively retained through naming consumer
source WalkDir and support matrix documentation
optional acceptance.json glob; unowned path forces full
Python-launch Go native service via root workflow
Python-discovered peer consumers in existing qualification workflow
production/test fixtures and platform/CGO/tag contexts are full; no static import closure claim
